content_types.name: Signal Alert
content_types.desc: A Prophet plan turned into a cashtag post with a price chart showing where we see opportunity.

content_types.name: Chart of the Day
content_types.desc: A single annotated price or macro chart that tells one clear story without commentary.

content_types.name: Plain-English Explainer
content_types.desc: A short thread or post that explains one market concept so a non-professional can act on it.

content_types.name: Macro Note
content_types.desc: A brief plain read on the big picture (rates, liquidity, growth) and what it means right now.

content_types.name: Report Card
content_types.desc: A public update on how a past call played out: the numbers, the outcome, what we learned.

content_types.name: On Our Radar
content_types.desc: A short list of names we're watching closely this week but haven't acted on yet.

content_types.name: Event Reaction
content_types.desc: A fast-turnaround post reacting to a market-moving event with context and what we'd watch next.

content_types.name: Mover of the Day
content_types.desc: The day's single biggest mover, charted, on its cashtag, with the real move %.

content_types.name: Theme Tape
content_types.desc: One post tagged with 6-10 cashtags covering a group that's moving, the reach king at 0 followers.

accounts.name: What changed and why it matters

queue.body:
$EGBN held 28.1, its busiest price of the past six months.
Below 28.1, that support is gone.

queue.headline: $KLAC is still inside its main volume range
queue.body: Most of the recent volume traded from 170 to 222. Above that range, the structure changes.
$PVH at 74. Below 66.5, the setup is gone.
$FIX has climbed 5 weeks straight into the six-month volume peak at 1747.

queue.headline: $LMAT is back near its low
queue.body: After 3 red closes, 78.2 has to hold.

queue.headline: $ROK buyers keep showing up at 432
queue.body: 6 times across the three-year stretch.

queue.headline: $DVN just lined up a pattern we track.
queue.body: Across every name we test it on, this combination has resolved higher 70% of the time about a month out over its full tested history, over 512 occurrences universe-wide, not this one name. A measured tendency on a study split, not our trading record. Chart below.

queue.headline: Semiconductors ripping, +2.7% avg on Friday
queue.body: $WOLF +13.2% $ACLS +8.1% $TER +8.0% $CAMT +7.4% $STM +7.0% $ASX +6.1% $ON +6.0% $AMKR +5.9% The whole group is bid, not one name.
Rep. Kevin Hern sold $MRSH. The filing surfaced 16 days later and names the trade, not the reason.
A large $GBR shareholder increased its disclosed stake 6x. The filing confirms the purchase but doesn't explain why it was made.

accounts.name: Founder's desk: the day's tape, two facts set against each other

queue.headline: $NTCT keeps defending the same cost basis
queue.body: 10 straight sessions above 39.4, the average price paid since the September volume spike. Below that level, the hold is gone.

$MKSI closed back above 277, the average price paid since the volume spike.
Lose that level again and the reclaim becomes a failed move.

queue.headline: $ITW prints its narrowest range in 7 sessions
queue.body: A break above today's range starts the trade. Until then, the six-month range still owns it.

queue.headline: $LMAT is back just above its yearly low
queue.body: Below 76.4, the floor gives way.
Back at 132, where $DKS traded most over six months. Still holding.
$OTTR held where trading concentrated. Below 81.1, the floor is gone.
Rep. Kevin Hern sold $CR. The filing surfaced 25 days later, and congressional disclosures don't say why.

accounts.name: Crowd translator — market psychology, mood vs positioning, consumer and tech stories with market consequence

queue.body:
$ROK found buyers at shorter-term support again.
5 tests in the past year, 5 holds.

$ELF needs 99.5 to hold.
A loss of that level kills the setup.
$FTI needs to reclaim the 74.1 entry level before the rebound is real.

queue.headline: $GNRC keeps finding buyers at the same line
queue.body: 213 drew buyers for the 6th time in the past year, and the stock reclaimed it.
Rep. Kevin Hern sold $50K to $100K of $PTC. The disclosure doesn't explain why.

accounts.name: Narrative architect — the story that organises the market, the incentives holding it together, and the fact that changes its meaning

queue.body:
$KLAC has closed green 3 weeks straight.
Above 222, the streak clears the main trading range.

queue.headline: $ELF still has to clear 106
queue.body: A break above that level puts 112 back in play. Until then, the recovery remains incomplete.
Below 103, $EBAY leaves six months of heavy traffic behind.
Rep. Kevin Hern's $AIO sale became public 25 days after the trade. Congressional filings are a record, not a timing tool.

accounts.name: Mechanism detective — cross-asset disagreement, what moved first, what is already priced, and the missing denominator

queue.body:
$WABC reclaimed 59.2 after 5 green weeks.
60.2 is where the most shares changed hands over the past six months.
the run now has to clear that price.

queue.headline: Hardware ripping, +1.1% avg on Friday
queue.body: $TBCH +9.4% $HPE +7.4% $DDD +6.8% $EXTR +5.2% $NTAP +5.2% $VIAV +5.2% $TXN +4.4% Breadth inside the group, not one leader.

accounts.name: Cross-border correspondent — Asia/HK session, A/H/ADR/FX/commodity transmission, and what New York inherits at the open

queue.headline: New York inherits a firmer US macro mix
queue.body: Jobless claims are averaging 200k a week this month, 11.0% below a year ago. Growth is firming while inflation is still warm.
PVH, $PVH, is testing 74. The setup needs a close above.

queue.headline: Industrial Automation ripping, +1.7% avg on Friday
queue.body: $OUST +8.6% $CGNX +4.4% $PRLB +4.1% $NOVT +4.0% The whole group is bid, not one name.
A $GME director opened a new position with a $255K purchase. The filing confirms the buy, but doesn't tell us why.
$ORCL director's disclosed stake is now 65x its prior size. The filing doesn't say why.
